reading_log.notes: Read the complete PVRP/MDP formulation and profile/weight embeddings, four attention relations and conflict resolution; Figure 2 still requires direct visual inspection.

Read PSR Eq5, constructive parallel decoder and REINFORCE, training/test budgets and Tables1–2. Explicit one checkpoint varies alpha/profile constraints rather than automatically multiple native tasks; Eq5 profile sign and nonfinite handling need code/visual comparison.

Read full Tables3–5, alpha visualization explanation and conclusions/limitations. Table3 N1000/M30,50,70 differs protocol prose N500/M15,25,35; neural gaps remain14.15/19.35 percent to HGS, so conclusion matching/exceeding classical requires qualification. PVRPLib adds synthetic profiles to CVRPLib.
Read complete two-page bibliography; note duplicate POPPY year entries and printed NeurIPS36/year mismatches, and preserve actual cited preprint titles/years when constructing supported edges.

Read final bibliography and supplementary PVRP definition/constraints and state formulation. Printed MILP lacks explicit x-y linking, depot connectivity/subtour constraints and explicit hard-profile restrictions; flow conservation alone does not imply single depot-connected tour. Qualify this printed formulation without assuming decoder infeasibility.

Read complete MDP action/reward/termination, synthetic profile and angular-zone generation and additional experimental protocol. Depot return resets capacity whereas printed MILP bounds total demand per vehicle, so distinguish MDP implementation from incomplete displayed program. Main and supplementary test-scale prose differs Table3.

Read all Table6 hyperparameters, Table7 asset licenses and Tables8–9 medium/large results. N200 and500 sampled gaps12.03/12.97 percent to HGS; no claim of beating the HGS reference. All16 arxiv v2 pages now fully read.
